architecture: Qt Widgets and QSynEdit in C++; external Rust toolchain, rust-analyzer LSP and CodeLLDB DAP

features.feature: Files, editing, selection, undo/redo, search/replace, bookmarks, TODO, split views
features.implementation: Reused QSynEdit and shared Qt services; Rust syntax, indentation and file templates added
Cargo manifests and RustProjectOptions replace .dev projects/compiler-set controls; profiles, packages, targets, features, platform, arguments and environment
Cargo for projects; rustc for standalone .rs files without Cargo.toml; bounded asynchronous processes and descendants
Rust JSON spans converted from one-based Unicode scalar coordinates to zero-based editor UTF-16 coordinates
Explicit Cargo/rustfmt commands and rustfmt buffer formatting on save; Cargo edition and workspace inheritance read through toml++; stale buffers rejected
rust-analyzer; simple LSP snippets, completion preferences, keyword/snippet filters and bounded hints
Inherited definition/declaration/reference/rename actions routed to Rust; F12/Ctrl-click, workspace symbols, code actions, macro expansion and previewed multi-file edits
checks: GUI menu/mouse definitions, references, rename and reentry

features.implementation: Bounded RustOutlineModel with owned snapshots and monotonic IDs; unambiguous inherent impl grouping, colored symbol icons scaled to tree font, name/type/source sorting and trait-impl visibility
Rust collections and new-file template in inherited editor preferences; Cargo creates project scaffolds

CodeLLDB DAP with ConPTY, source/conditional/hit/log/function breakpoints, run-to-cursor, stepping, threads, stack, variables, watches, value editing, supported data breakpoints, memory and disassembly
checks: GUI real debugger and stale variable dialog

features.implementation: Reused Git services, asynchronous tool verification and dedicated Rust repository identity
Verified Cargo target, preview and recycle bin; source/open-document/link protection, snapshot revalidation, bounded sharing retries, cancellation between moves and retryable partial failures
Atomic live folder/file journal, periodic bounded document recovery, native Windows crash log/dump and next-start notice
Rust tool paths/edition, completion/tooltips restored, geometry values bounded; Rust executable/window/about icons and correct copyright/source links

language_specific_replacements: C/C++ compiler sets, .dev projects, headers and compiler/parser flags replaced by Cargo/Rust options and files
C/C++ preprocess/GIMPLE operations replaced by Rust assembly/LLVM IR where meaningful
C/C++ inherited-class toggle replaced by visibility of explicit Rust trait implementations
Competitive-programming C/C++ panels replaced by Cargo/rustc tests
Header hover and GDB-specific hover controls are not exposed; runtime inspection is in the Rust Debug panel
limits: LSP resource operations that create/rename/delete files and arbitrary server commands are not applied
Complex LSP snippet transforms, nesting and repeated placeholder references are not expanded
Only unambiguous simple inherent impls are grouped under their declared type; constrained/generic and trait impls retain their own nodes
Cancellation of recycling waits for the current native operating-system move to finish
External Rust tools and CodeLLDB are installed/configured separately; Linux delivery is deferred
